Commercial towing vessel of the 1979 film.

How USCSS Nostromo connects

  • Faction: Nostromo crew — The crew lives and dies aboard the Nostromo.
  • Work: Alien (1979) — Alien (1979) is largely set on the Nostromo.

What is USCSS Nostromo?

The Nostromo is the locked industrial ship whose ducts, vents, and Jones the cat make Alien a haunted house in space.
